body: After round 2 (2026-11-21, v0.2.1): P3 is 144 built, 4 partial, 8 not built; P4 is 51 built, 3 partial, 16 not built (counts in the private BUILD_STATUS notes). Not built in P3: FC-09 (Hatchet sticky workers only), BK-07 (Temporal server), BK-08 (cloud schedulers) and the broker rows MQ-05, MQ-11, MQ-13, MQ-14, MQ-17. Not built in P4: WC-28, WC-31, WC-33, WC-38, WC-41, WC-42 (graph or token engine semantics), WX-06, WX-07, WX-09, WX-10 (human task management), WP-30 (needs a broker), XM-05, XM-06, XM-11, XM-13, and BK-10 (out of scope, owner 2026-11-20). Partial: P3 WC-15, WX-05, WX-13, MQ-08; P4 WC-08, WX-08, IO-01. Scope of anything further to be chosen by the owner (propose in/defer/skip first).
title: P3 and P4 feature rows: 8 P3 and 16 P4 rows not built remain
